title: Alexandr Wang says startups supercharged by AI can now pick 'Goliath versus Goliath' fights
excerpt: He said that if a startup embraces AI agents in the "most ambitious ways," they can easily beat incumbent companies.
content_html:
It's never been easier to take on the big guys, says Alexandr Wang.

At a talk at a Y Combinator event, the Scale AI founder, who now leads Meta's Superintelligence Labs, said that AI has been a game changer for startups.

"It's probably a once in a civilization opportunity to be a dreamer and to have a vision and to have ambition and to impose a view of how the future world should look by building something amazing," Wang said in a video from the event released on Wednesday.

He said that it wasn't so easy when he started his AI training company in 2016. Scale AI is among the earliest data labeling companies — it pays thousands of contractors around the world to filter, rank, and train AI responses for the world's largest AI labs. Wang, who was CEO, left Scale to join Meta last June as part of a $14.3 billion deal the social media company made with his startup.

"It was like David versus Goliath. You had to be clever, and you had to find an angle into the market and figure out a way to compete even though you had much fewer resources," Wang said. "Now I actually think with the power of agents and AI broadly speaking it's much closer to Goliath versus Goliath."

He added that if a startup embraces AI agents in the "most ambitious ways," it can easily beat incumbent companies. AI agents are software systems that can sef complete multi-step tasks such as writing code or handling customer support.

Wang's comments on now being a generational moment to launch a business closely echo what Silicon Valley's top voices have said about the subject.

At the same YC event, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman reiterated his stance on AI's potential for startups.

"I think we'll go through a very steep period, which again, never a better time to do a startup than right now," Altman said. "I hope we can say that again every year from now on, but it's certainly true about this moment in history."

Famed tech investor Vinod Khosla predicted that AI will lead to a small-business boom because entrepreneurs can outsource tasks like legal and accounting work to AI.

"I would guess by 2035, 10 years from now, that's a very short time, we will have 1/4 the number of corporate employees, maybe less, and we will have 50 million micro entrepreneurs doing their thing, being their own boss," he said on a May podcast.

content_html_zh:
亚历山大·王 (Alexandr Wang) 表示，与大人物较量从未如此简单。

在 Y Combinator 活动的一次演讲中，现任 Meta 超级智能实验室负责人的 Scale AI 创始人表示，人工智能已经改变了初创公司的游戏规则。

王在周三发布的活动视频中表示：“这可能是一个千载难逢的机会，让你成为一个梦想家，拥有远见和雄心，通过建造一些令人惊叹的东西来强加对未来世界应该是什么样子的看法。”

他说，2016年他创办人工智能培训公司时，一切并不那么容易。 Scale AI 是最早的数据标记公司之一——它向世界各地数千名承包商付费，为世界上最大的人工智能实验室过滤、排名和训练人工智能响应。 去年 6 月，担任首席执行官的 Wang 离开 Scale，加入 Meta，这是这家社交媒体公司与他的初创公司达成的 143 亿美元交易的一部分。

“这就像大卫对抗歌利亚。 你必须很聪明，即使你的资源少得多，你也必须找到进入市场的角度并找到竞争的方法，”王说。 “现在我实际上认为，从广义上讲，凭借代理和人工智能的力量，它更接近歌利亚与歌利亚。”

他补充说，如果一家初创公司以“最雄心勃勃的方式”拥抱人工智能代理，它就可以轻松击败现有公司。 人工智能代理是可以完成多步骤任务的软件系统，例如编写代码或处理客户支持。

王对于现在是一代人创办企业的时刻的评论与硅谷高层人士对此主题的看法非常相似。

在同一个 YC 活动中，OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 重申了他对人工智能对初创公司潜力的立场。

奥尔特曼说：“我认为我们将经历一个非常艰难的时期，这对于创业来说再一次没有比现在更好的时机了。” “我希望从现在起我们每年都能这么说，但对于历史上的这一时刻来说，这确实是事实。”

著名科技投资者 Vinod Khosla 预测，人工智能将带来小企业的繁荣，因为企业家可以将法律和会计工作等任务外包给人工智能。

“我猜想到 2035 年，即 10 年后，这是一个非常短的时间，我们的企业员工数量将减少 1/4，甚至更少，我们将有 5000 万微型企业家做自己的事情，自己当老板，”他在 5 月份的播客中说道。
